_note: Every value is extracted from a claim quote or counted from the council's vote rows by compute.py, or computed here from values that were.

cameras_2022.basis: cameras in the 2022 Flock Safety lease, per the resolution's title

lease_2022_usd.basis: the 2022 lease's not to exceed amount, dollars

cameras_2023.basis: cameras in the restated 2023 Flock Group lease, per the resolution's title

lease_2023_usd.basis: the 2023 agreement's not to exceed amount, dollars

dickinson_cameras.basis: Flock cameras the 2024 agreement places inside Dickinson

cameras_tribune.basis: Flock cameras the Tribune reports Proposition A asks about

population_tribune.basis: League City's population as the Tribune states it

agencies_floor.basis: agencies with access to League City's Flock data, a floor, per the Tribune

searches_per_30_days.basis: League City police searches in an average 30 day period, roughly, per the Tribune

search_window_days.basis: the averaging window in days, per the Tribune

officers_with_access.basis: officers with access to the system, per the mayor via the Tribune

officers_per_search.basis: officers who must work together to scan the data, per the Tribune

hours_after_certification.basis: hours after certification when bagging starts, per the mayor via the Tribune

removal_votes_for.basis: counted: rows reading For in the council's vote record on Resolution No. 2026-185 of October 13th, 2026

removal_votes_absent.basis: counted: rows reading Absent in the council's vote record on Resolution No. 2026-185 of October 13th, 2026

removal_roll.basis: counted: names on the council's vote record on Resolution No. 2026-185 of October 13th, 2026

removal_votes_against.basis: counted: rows reading Against in the council's vote record on Resolution No. 2026-185 of October 13th, 2026

election_order_votes_for.basis: counted: rows reading For in the council's vote record on Ordinance No. 2026-27 of August 11th, 2026

election_order_votes_absent.basis: counted: rows reading Absent in the council's vote record on Ordinance No. 2026-27 of August 11th, 2026

election_order_roll.basis: counted: names on the council's vote record on Ordinance No. 2026-27 of August 11th, 2026

election_order_votes_against.basis: counted: rows reading Against in the council's vote record on Ordinance No. 2026-27 of August 11th, 2026

lease_2023_votes_for.basis: counted: rows reading For in the council's vote record on Resolution No. 2023-197 of December 12th, 2023

lease_2023_votes_absent.basis: counted: rows reading Absent in the council's vote record on Resolution No. 2023-197 of December 12th, 2023

lease_2023_roll.basis: counted: names on the council's vote record on Resolution No. 2023-197 of December 12th, 2023

lease_2023_votes_against.basis: counted: rows reading Against in the council's vote record on Resolution No. 2023-197 of December 12th, 2023

cameras_added_2023.basis: computed: cameras in the 2023 lease less cameras in the 2022 lease

lease_minus_tribune.basis: computed: the most cameras the 2023 lease covers less the cameras the Tribune counts. Two kinds of number, never a count of removed cameras

removal_to_election_days.basis: computed: days from the October 13th removal vote to the November 3rd election

order_to_election_days.basis: computed: days from the August 11th election order to the November 3rd election

first_lease_to_election_years.basis: computed: calendar years from the first lease's approval to the election

years_of_council_votes.basis: the years of the council's Flock votes, from their records

league_city_lat.basis: the Census 2020 gazetteer interior point latitude

league_city_lon.basis: the Census 2020 gazetteer interior point longitude

kyle_lat.basis: the Census 2020 gazetteer interior point latitude

kyle_lon.basis: the Census 2020 gazetteer interior point longitude

laredo_lat.basis: the Census 2020 gazetteer interior point latitude

laredo_lon.basis: the Census 2020 gazetteer interior point longitude
